P7764.corridor_notes: “气化庆阳”天然气输气干线宁县段：起于湘乐镇首站，经湘乐镇分输阀室、寨子河分输阀室，止于宁县分输清管阀站，全长35.88公里，辐射十八个乡镇和两个工业园区；2024-12-02完成设备联调、压力测试、氮气置换后进入试运行阶段。
P7764.researcher_notes: China Gansu Net (gansu.gscn.com.cn, provincial state-media outlet) confirms GEM's StartLocation=Xiangle / EndLocation=Ning County at finer station-level granularity (湘乐镇首站 / 宁县分输清管阀站). Source length (35.88km) is close to but not identical with GEM's LengthMergedKm (35.46km) — flagging the minor discrepancy, not correcting.
